notes: Two-factor authentication: open Settings > Security, scan the QR code with an authenticator app (or enter the key manually), then confirm a 6-digit code. Sign-in now asks for the code after your password, and you receive ten single-use recovery codes shown only once. Turning 2FA off requires your password plus a current authenticator or recovery code. Nobody can recover your password from the server; existing accounts and sessions keep working unchanged until 2FA is enabled.
